questions.question: What is this platform about?
questions.answer: Our platform connects buyers with verified livestock sellers, providing a seamless way to purchase animals for Qurbani/ Eid al-Adha. We ensure quality, transparency, and ethical practices throughout the process.

questions.question: How do I place an order?
questions.answer: Simply browse our collection of animals, select your preferred choice, and proceed to checkout. You can choose between pickup or delivery options based on your location.

questions.question: What payment methods are accepted?
questions.answer: We accept various payment methods including credit/ debit cards, mobile banking (bKash, Nagad), and bank transfers. All transactions are secure and encrypted.

questions.question: How do you ensure animal quality?
questions.answer: All our animals are sourced from verified farms and undergo strict health checks. We provide detailed information about each animal's breed, age, weight, and health status.

questions.question: Can I inspect the animal before purchase?
questions.answer: Yes! You can visit our farm or partner locations to personally inspect the animals. We also provide live video calls for remote customers.

questions.question: What happens if the animal gets sick?
questions.answer: We provide a health guarantee for all animals. If any health issues arise within the specified period, we offer replacement or full refund.

questions.question: What are the delivery options?
questions.answer: We offer doorstep delivery, farm pickup, and designated collection points. Delivery is available across major cities in Bangladesh.

questions.question: How much does delivery cost?
questions.answer: Delivery costs vary based on location and animal size. Free delivery is available for orders within Dhaka city limits.

questions.question: What is the delivery timeline?
questions.answer: Standard delivery takes 2-3 days. For Eid season, we recommend ordering at least one week in advance to ensure timely delivery.

questions.question: What is your refund policy?
questions.answer: We offer full refunds within 24 hours of purchase if you're unsatisfied. For delivery issues, refunds are processed within 5-7 business days.

questions.question: Can I cancel my order?
questions.answer: Yes, you can cancel your order before the animal is dispatched. Contact our support team immediately for assistance.
